functions.name: generate_token
functions.docstring:
Generate a secure random token.

Args:
    length: Length of token in bytes
    
Returns:
    Hexadecimal token string

functions.name: generate_verification_code
functions.docstring:
Generate a numeric verification code.

Args:
    length: Length of code
    
Returns:
    Numeric verification code

functions.name: hash_content
functions.docstring:
Hash content using specified algorithm.

Args:
    content: Content to hash
    algorithm: Hash algorithm (sha256, sha512, md5)
    
Returns:
    Hexadecimal hash string

functions.name: generate_api_key
functions.docstring:
Generate an API key.

Returns:
    API key string

functions.name: mask_email
functions.docstring:
Mask email address for privacy.

Args:
    email: Email address to mask

Returns:
    Masked email address

functions.name: mask_sensitive_data
functions.docstring:
Mask sensitive data, showing only specified number of characters.

Args:
    data: Data to mask
    show_chars: Number of characters to show at end
    
Returns:
    Masked data
